bug_semantics: Spring Security SAML2 SP decrypts EncryptedAssertion/EncryptedID (login Response) and EncryptedID (LogoutRequest) without a successful signature check, so a network attacker can submit crafted unsigned or invalidly signed SAML XML and use distinct decryption vs signature failures as a decryption oracle (CWE-347). In the surviving pre-fix process() path, response.isSigned()/assertion.isSigned() (signature present) gates responseElementsDecrypter/assertionElementsDecrypter while responseSignatureValidator/assertionSignatureValidator errors are only accumulated; OpenSAML DecryptionException is thrown immediately as Saml2ErrorCodes.DECRYPTION_ERROR. LogoutRequest validation ran verifySignature and validateSubject as accumulating consumers, so getNameId() still called withDecryptionKeys(...).decrypt(request) after an invalid signature. LogoutResponse had the same fail-open signature accumulation (no EncryptedID decrypt in-tree). Attack needs the SP decryption private key path to run, hence CVSS AC:H.
flaw_origin: First written in the SAML2 login MVP: OpenSamlAuthenticationProvider.validateSaml2Response() always called decrypt(token, EncryptedAssertion) before requiring a valid response/assertion signature, and getUsername() decrypted EncryptedID on the selected assertion. That first-write is e9a44bc0ce (PR #7260, Fixes gh-6019), a single-member feature commit merged by 08d50868c9; parent b5cbab01 has no saml2 module. Later refactors (5bfc6ea25a, d0581c9a26 isSigned() gate, 80b31820cd move to BaseOpenSamlAuthenticationProvider) kept decrypt-without-valid-signature. Logout EncryptedID decrypt was added later (700cae8d3b) with the same accumulate-then-decrypt pattern.

Lineage of the pre-fix process() decrypt-if-isSigned() block via git log -L and -S reaches e9a44bc0ce, which first added OpenSamlAuthenticationProvider and decrypted EncryptedAssertions unconditionally (and EncryptedID after selecting an assertion). Refactors through BaseOpenSamlAuthenticationProvider kept the flawed order (signature errors accumulated; decrypt still ran when a Signature element was present). OSS patches e50c2a6a74 (login) and cf06871200 (logout) invert that order and are in 6.5.11/7.0.6, matching the advisory patched boundary.
